MappingFields.Name: personId
MappingFields.Description: [Mandatory] Correlation value. Used to correlate an existing MultiBel account (account correlation field)

MappingFields.Name: multibelPersonId
MappingFields.Description: [Mandatory] Account reference. Filled with the multibelPersonId returned by MultiBel and stored in the account data

MappingFields.Name: phoneNumber1.countryCode
MappingFields.Description: [Optional] Country code of phone number 1 without + or 00, for example 31. Mandatory when phoneNumber1.number has a value

MappingFields.Name: phoneNumber1.number
MappingFields.Description: [Optional] Phone number 1 without country code and leading 0, for example 612345678. When empty, phone number 1 (number and countryCode) is cleared in MultiBel

MappingFields.Name: phoneNumber2.countryCode
MappingFields.Description: [Optional] Country code of phone number 2 without + or 00, for example 31. Mandatory when phoneNumber2.number has a value

MappingFields.Name: phoneNumber2.number
MappingFields.Description: [Optional] Phone number 2 without country code and leading 0, for example 612345678. When empty, phone number 2 (number and countryCode) is cleared in MultiBel
